author: Jeremiah
body:
Hey Stu, love the show!

I’ve been following the UT-01 race, which has been talked about a lot in Utah, but not much outside of Utah. The republican incumbent, Blake Moore, worked with the democrats in a “bipartisan effort” to redistrict the seat and basically give it to Democrats, and now he’s running for the nomination in UT-02.

Utah has a weird system where they do caucuses and also a primary, and for UT-01 a young Somali dude named Liban Mohamed won at convention, making him the “nominee” but two other challengers gathered enough signatures to also be on the ballot for the primary. Mohamed isn’t even showing up on Kalshi.

Ben McAdams is a more moderate, blue dog democrat who was the UT-02 seat for only one cycle before losing to Burgess Owens who is in the seat now. The other candidate is Nate Blouin, who is a young communist that is loud on Twitter, which plays in deep blue Salt Lake, but not for the rest of the district. He has also recently had tweets leak that are negative towards the LDS church, which is obviously a major demographic in Utah.

Because the way the seat was redistricted, democrats will certainly win the seat, but it’s only about 90% right now. For the nominee, Kalshi has McAdams at about 80% and Blouin at 20%. McAdams will almost certainly win, but I have positions with Blouin at no. So that’s the one that I’ve been watching. The primary is June 23rd.
